ui.lead: Downloads videos and photos from Douyin. No account needed.
ui.detect_hint: A profile link or a single video/post link. Share text copied from the app works too.
ui.paste_hint_desktop: Click the box and paste with Ctrl+V.
ui.paste_hint_mobile: Press and hold the box, then choose Paste.
ui.mode_single_desc: One video or one photo album
ui.mode_profile_desc: All posts by this person, in bulk
ui.mode_profile_desc_owner: All posts by the person who shared this post
ui.compat_desc: Downloads videos as H.264. If you turn this off, some videos are smaller but may not open in every player.
ui.form_need_mode: Choose what to download: just this post or the whole profile?
ui.sub_login_open_desktop: You can sign in in the window that opened. Close that window when you are done.
ui.sub_login_open_mobile: You can sign in on the screen that opened. Tap 'Done' when you are finished.
ui.sub_starting: The first start can take a few seconds.
ui.sub_collecting: Found posts are downloading one by one. The page scrolls by itself.
ui.note_captcha_body_desktop: Complete the puzzle or checkbox in the browser window that opened. The program is waiting and will continue by itself.
ui.note_captcha_body_mobile: Complete the puzzle on the screen that opened. The app is waiting and will continue by itself.
ui.note_login_wall: Without signing in, Douyin showed only part of this profile. To get everything, sign in once and start again with the same link. Files already downloaded will not be downloaded again.
ui.overlay_captcha_title: Douyin verification: solve the puzzle (pinch to zoom if it is small)
ui.confirm_leave: A download is running. It will stop if you leave.
summary.unmatched: {n} posts skipped because they did not match your selection
link.tiktok: This is a TikTok link. This program only works with Douyin (douyin.com) links.
link.not_found: No Douyin link found in the text. Copy the link from the address bar and paste it.
link.short_incomplete: The short link looks incomplete. Copy the whole link.
link.live: This is a live stream link. Live streams cannot be downloaded.
link.self: This is your own profile page. Paste the profile link of the person you want to download.
link.profile_broken: The profile link looks incomplete or broken. Copy the whole link.
link.collection: This is a collection (合集) link. For now, profile and single post links are supported.
link.music: This is a music page link. For now, profile and single post links are supported.
link.no_target: This link does not point to a specific video or profile. Open the video or profile and copy the link from the address bar.
link.short_bad: The short link opened, but it did not lead to a video or profile.
link.short_detected: Short link detected. Whether it is a video or a profile will be known once it opens.
engine.single_needs_post: This is a profile link. To download a single post, paste the video's own link or choose 'Whole profile'.
engine.unexpected_summary: An unexpected error occurred. Details are in the log below.
engine.login_done: Sign-in screen closed. If you signed in, it will be used for the next download.
engine.folder_failed: Could not create the download folder: {path} ({error})
engine.short_to_profile: The short link opened a profile. To download the whole profile, choose 'Whole profile'.
engine.owner_not_found: Could not find the profile of this post's owner.
engine.private: This account is private (私密账号). Posts of private accounts cannot be downloaded.
engine.no_list: Could not get the post list from the profile. The Douyin page may not have loaded or its layout may have changed. Check the link and try again.
engine.login_wall: Without signing in, Douyin showed only {n} posts. To get them all, sign in once with 'Sign in to Douyin' and start again.
engine.login_wall_total: Without signing in, Douyin showed only {n} posts (the profile has {total}). To get them all, sign in once with 'Sign in to Douyin' and start again.
skip.no_video: no video address found; it may be deleted, private or paid
fetch.html_page: The server returned a page instead of a file (access may be blocked).
browser.load_failed: Could not load the browser component: {error}
browser.none: No browser could be opened. Edge may be broken and the backup browser could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and restart the program. Details: {detail}
browser.edge_broken: Edge on this computer looks incomplete (an unfinished update). Another browser will be used.
browser.profile_in_use: The browser profile is in use in another window. If another Douyin Downloader window is open, close it and try again.
browser.opened: {name} opened. Do not close this window until the job is done.
browser.opened_mobile: The Douyin page opened in the background.
browser.closed: The browser window was closed. The job was stopped.
browser.captcha: Douyin wants a verification. Complete it in the browser window that opened; the program is waiting.
browser.captcha_mobile: Douyin wants a verification. Complete the puzzle on the screen that opened; the app is waiting.
browser.captcha_timeout: The verification was not completed within 15 minutes. Try again.
browser.no_internet: No internet connection, or Douyin cannot be reached.
browser.page_failed: The page could not be opened: {error}
browser.slow: The page is opening slowly; continuing with what has loaded.
browser.short_failed: The short link did not open a video or profile. Make sure the link is correct.
browser.post_failed: Could not get this post's details. It may be deleted, private or visible only to signed-in users.
browser.dom_fallback: The list could not be read directly; {n} posts will be opened one by one.
browser.login_open: Douyin is open. You can sign in (optional). Close the browser window when you are done.
browser.login_open_mobile: Douyin is open. You can sign in (optional). Tap 'Done' when you are finished.
chromium.downloading: Downloading the program's own browser (about 150 MB, only the first time). This can take a few minutes…
chromium.failed: The browser component could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection. {detail}
server.no_folder_dialog: The folder picker is only available on Windows. You can type the path in the box.
app.edge_broken_box:
Edge on this computer looks broken (possibly an unfinished update).

The program is downloading its own browser (about 150 MB, only this time). The window will open by itself in a few minutes.
app.download_failed_box: The browser component could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and restart the program.
app.window_failed_box: The window could not be opened. Open this address in your browser: {url}
android.notif_captcha: Douyin wants a verification. Open the app.
android.no_window: The app screen is closed. Open the app and try again.
android.no_gallery_app: Could not open a gallery app. Downloads are in Gallery › Douyin.
